subject: english-literature
title: Themes Across Texts
welcome_lead: Pair a theme with a text and you have an essay's spine.
meta_desc: KS3 English Literature adventure on tracing themes across multiple texts.
final_note: You can now pair classic texts with their core themes.

concepts.def: Whole story standing for an idea.

walkthroughs.body_html: A symbol can be one-off (a single rose). A motif is a symbol or image that recurs, helping develop theme.
Animal Farm is an allegory for the Russian Revolution: characters and events stand for real history.
Turn a theme into a sentence: 'Loyalty can outlast death.' That theme statement guides essay paragraphs.
